name: Camogli (Italy)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Camogli (a sailing ship on the sea beneath a star on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Camogli, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Camogli arms — sailing ship on the sea beneath a star on blue, crowned, within branches
